Enchantments
  • +5 Enhancement Bonus+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
  • Vertigo +6 Vertigo +6: This effect gives a +6 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
  • Tendon Slice 6%Tendon Slice 6%: This effect gives a 6% chance to Hamstring the target for each attack that does damage.
  • AdamantineAdamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
  • Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.
    (This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
Upgradeable?
Description A complex staff-like weapon that is enchanted to allow almost anyone to use it with some skill.
Tips

Shining Crescents is unique in several ways (April 2016 tests ARCHIVE ME!):

  • It is the only two-handed light weapon in DDO, meaning it is the only finesse-able two-hander. Thus it's the only finesse weapon that can gain +10 damage from Power Attack.
  • Separately, pure monks are not proficient with this item but it still allows monks to treat it as a ki weapon, remaining centered and with access to most of their class's special attacks when holding it.
  • The weapon's type is Sickle, so it benefits from the Feats Improved Critical: Slashing Weapons and Weapon Focus: Slashing Weapons.
  • Because it uses the quarterstaff attack animations, it benefits from the Rogue Thief Acrobatics enhancement for up to +15% attack speed and is a valid weapon for use with Quick Strike, Sweeping Strikes, Staff Lunge, and Vault.
    • But because it is not typed as a quarterstaff, Thief-Acrobat Staff Control, Stick Fighting, Acrobat Staff Training, and Staff Specialization do not apply to it.
  • Despite its being a light weapon:
    • it is not compatible with Swashbuckling or a Shadar-kai's chain attack.
    • it cannot be used with an off-hand weapon (it's two-handed).
  • Despite being a two-handed weapon, it can benefit from Single Weapon Fighting feats.

Bug: Shining Crescents currently benefits from Single Weapon Fighting feats, even though it is a two-handed weapon. This will be fixed in a future update.DDO Forums ARCHIVE ME!

If making a cosmetic version of this item with a Mirror of Glamering, note that it will only function correctly when a quarterstaff is equipped, as it uses the Quarterstaff animation set despite being a Sickle. Glamered Weapon Auras will not work on the cosmetic.

2026 tests

  • You can Strikethrough with this weapon and hit multiple targets.
  • Thief Acrobat: Quarterstaff attack speed bonus seems to apply and special quarterstaff attacks work.
  • SWF + Offline Versatility:
    • Icons are displayed.
    • Melee Power bonus works.
    • Attack speed bonus probably does not work (fully?); needs more tests. (Slower than a plain sickle.)
    • Extra damage from ability score does not seem to work. (Observed damage range 13-23 at 23 dex [+6 bonus], which corresponds to 2-12+5+6.)
  • Swashbuckling does NOT work.
  • Shadar-Kai Chain attacks do NOT work.
